description: Detect spots and regions in imaging data and persist them, with their pixels, into the measurement's container.

rpc_methods.name: spot_finder.detect.run
rpc_methods.summary: Detect regions in one or more images and write them to their containers.

files.description: Images to detect in — TIFF stacks or TTTR imaging files.

name.description: Stem the label raster and region table are written under.

channels.description: Routing channels for a photon file; every channel present by default.

frame.description: Frame to detect in; -1 sums over frames.

write.description: Write each detection into its container; off makes this a dry run.

out_dir.description: Directory for the containers; beside each file by default.

workflow.description: Workflow to start from — a shipped name or a document. Default: single_molecule, the standard segmentation.

settings.description: Overrides on the workflow's settings (method, threshold, area limits, spot widths, region). An unknown key is refused, not ignored.

rpc_methods.name: spot_finder.workflow.list
rpc_methods.summary: Return the shipped detection workflows, the standard one first.

rpc_methods.name: spot_finder.workflow.prepare
rpc_methods.summary: Resolve detection inputs from a cross-plugin workflow context, without running.

workflow_context.description: Handoff from an earlier step: raw_files, channel_settings.

workflow.description: Workflow to start from. Default: single_molecule.
